gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-lao: Noto Sans Lao stands its lowercase well above the usual height, with mouths left open on c, e and a. Autour One goes first with a bold, pen-like line of constant weight, and that contrast keeps a long page lively.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-lao-loope: Round, loud, and sturdy. Autour One keeps its strokes uniform with no hairlines to vanish, while Noto Sans Lao Looped packs its words into solid blocks, so a larger heading over modestly sized text feels right.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Noto Sans Lepcha reads wide and sturdy, its lowercase standing like cast iron capitals. Autour One is best at bold, expressive display, with stems matching hairlines because none exist, while the body font simply keeps text open.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Wide, gaping curves and tall small letters give Noto Sans Limbu a friendly, contemporary look beside the bold Autour One. Its strongest quality is the contrast.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Tight, tidy, and quietly professional, Noto Sans Lisu keeps ascenders close to the x-height line and curves its s wide open. And Autour One does the loud work, with terminals that end as wide as they began.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Noto Sans Lydian reads approachably, with capitals barely taller than lowercase and openings like a sprung paper clip. And Autour One sits above it, drawn in a single constant line width, giving the page a bold start and a gentle follow-through.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Noto Sans Mahajani brings lowercase that stands tall against its capitals, plus a funnel-wide throat in the e. Noto Sans Mahajani then takes over from Autour One, whose wire-smooth line glides under the eye, and the two share the page easily.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Approachable and wide-awake, Noto Sans Malayalam lets the middle zone dominate each line, with generous openings in its s. And Autour One is best at expressive display, with no brush-style swell anywhere, while the body font handles quiet text.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Noto Sans Mandaic lifts its lowercase close to the capitals, with curvy letters that feel unclamped. And Autour One keeps its lines holding their thickness, so a longer stretch of text moves along smoothly beneath it.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Noto Sans Marchen reads clean, its small letters standing proud and almost capital-sized, with curves ending in clear daylight. And Autour One does the showy work, drawing even its g in one unchanging line weight, while the body font quietly carries the text.
